description: DiggerLid PRO Excavator Enclosure 45s Meta ad — 12-frame storyboard.

RENDER MODE — STRICT BLACK AND WHITE PENCIL STORYBOARD SKETCH. The whole artwork is monochrome graphite + ink wash on warm cream sketchbook paper: loose hand-drawn pencil and marker lines, minimal shading, rough cinematic composition. Pencil tones only — no colour fills anywhere in the artwork. Any colour words below (yellow excavator, olive-green tarp, etc.) are descriptive labels identifying the real-world subject, NOT render instructions. The cream paper is the only off-white. One frame from a 12-frame storyboard series for a single 45-second ad.

[Context] Opening hero shot — establishes the $250k asset at stake.
[Visual] A Caterpillar 320 excavator parked alone at the edge of an Australian rural worksite at golden hour. Boom and bucket lowered. The operator cab is completely EMPTY and unprotected — no operator inside, no silhouette in the cab. In the foreground a tradesman in dusty hi-vis walks away from the machine, back to camera, silhouette stark against the low sun. Long shadows across compacted dirt and gravel. Eucalyptus and dust haze in the distance.
[Format] 9:16 vertical.
[Style] B&W storyboard sketch, loose pencil and marker lines, rough cinematic composition, no text.

A canvas tarp is half-draped over the cab roof, flapping wildly in heavy wind, partially exposing the operator seat and joystick controls inside. Rain streaks the cab glass. Heavy storm clouds, low setting sun behind. Mood of vulnerability.

[Context] Transition beat — the two DiggerLid founders introduce the solution. Direct address to camera. Show the OLD vs NEW contrast.
[Visual] Founder A and Founder B standing side-by-side at a workshop bench, looking down the lens. Navy work shirts, sleeves rolled, dust on forearms. Founder A on the LEFT (black cap) holds a clean folded section of grey ripstop fabric — sharp, neat, engineered. Founder B on the RIGHT (no cap, chevron moustache) holds an OBVIOUSLY OLD and WORN canvas tarp — sun-bleached, frayed at the edges, with holes and a torn grommet hanging loose. The contrast between the two pieces of fabric must be unmistakable. Behind them: pegboard with hand tools, a cutting mat on the bench.
[Format] 9:16 vertical.
[Style] B&W storyboard sketch, documentary portrait composition, no text. Strict pencil monochrome — no skin tones, no coloured mat.

[Context] Solution beat — the engineered cover being installed on a real excavator at a worksite. Single 3/4 angle, NOT a split panel.
[Visual] Single 3/4 angle composition at a sunlit outdoor Australian worksite — open sky, dirt ground, dust. A custom-fitted DiggerLid PRO Enclosure cover is being pulled snug over the cab of a Caterpillar 320 excavator. In the same frame, a tradesman's gloved hand clips a black YKK plastic side-release buckle onto a DiggerLid-branded tie-down tether point on the side of the cab. The cover is taut, no slack. One unified composition — do not split into panels.
[Format] 9:16 vertical, single composition.
[Style] B&W storyboard sketch, dynamic action composition, strict pencil monochrome, no colour fills.

Render this frame as a clean minimalist Australian/European designer-brand fashion editorial photograph (NOT a sketch). PURE WHITE seamless studio backdrop. A model wears a soft slightly-loose white cotton crew-neck tee tucked into light wash medium-weight relaxed/wide-leg blue denim jeans with classic five-pocket construction and tonal contrast stitching, plus burnt-cognac suede flat shoes. Soft even daylight, shadow-free. Hair pulled back. Premium minimalist register, hyperreal denim texture.

[Context] Connotative leap — moves YKK hardware from industrial accessory to premium designer-apparel register.
[Visual] Tight three-quarter angle close-up cropped from upper thigh to lower belt line. The brass YKK zipper pull at the front fly fills roughly 25% of the frame, perfectly TACK-SHARP with the embossed 'YKK' letters legible. The denim weave around the fly is in soft focus, getting dreamier toward the edges. The model's body, face and any visible skin are SOFT-FOCUSED / BLURRED — anonymous, identity not readable. A blur of the model's hand hovers near the pocket.
[Format] 9:16 vertical.
[Style] Editorial fashion photography, beautiful natural side light, hyperreal denim and brass detail, shallow depth of field. The YKK zipper pull is the only sharp element. Warm neutrals, light indigo denim, brass, cognac.
